delhi_token.daily_cap_note: Delhi Traffic Police release 50,000 challans per day for download on the token portal, up to a total cap of 2 lakh challans per Lok Adalat.
delhi_token.limits_note: For the March 2026 sitting, tokens opened on 9 March (five days before the sitting) and a maximum of 5 challans per vehicle could be processed; the eligibility cutoff (challans pending up to 31 October 2025 for that edition) and exact per-vehicle limits are announced afresh for each edition.

delhi_extras.digital_lok_adalat_note: DSLSA organised a special Lok Adalat exclusively for traffic challans across all Delhi district court complexes on 14 February 2026 and launched a Digital Lok Adalat application for settling traffic matters.
delhi_extras.weekend_courts_note: Weekend traffic courts run from 5 July 2026 at all Delhi district court complexes — second Saturday and every Sunday, 10 am to 4 pm — for compoundable challans only; evening courts sit 5 pm to 7 pm on working days. Challan slips are downloaded from the Delhi Traffic Police portal, choosing a court complex and slot.
